title: An early callable return removes a known function name from a union

ground_truth.statement: The local value has exactly two alternatives, strlen and [1]. strlen is callable and takes the early return. The one-element array is not callable and is the only alternative that reaches accept_array, so the call receives a list of integers.

notes: The runtime exhausts both boolean inputs. The expected absence of an argument-type diagnostic follows from the two alternatives, not from another analyzer's output.
